sections.title: Roster list and voice picker
sections.what: Shows a heading and a lead line saying the five analysts phrase verified facts but never add facts or imitate athletes. Shows a tile for each analyst, linking to its profile, with its sport, skill domain, and signature tool. Below the list, it shows the switchboard with the example voices.
sections.why: The lead line is the product's promise about the analysts. The list lets users open each one.
sections.watch_out: A new analyst appears in the tiles automatically, but it is picked in the switchboard only if the roster data also gives it a voice.

summary: Roster page that lists the five AI analysts and includes the voice picker.
purpose: Introduces the analysts and lets visitors compare their voices.
why: The product promises that analysts only rephrase verified facts, and this page states that promise.
how: Steps in order: it loads the switchboard data. It shows the heading and the promise. It lists each analyst as a tile. It then shows the voice picker.
inputs: The analyst list and the switchboard data.
risks: The lead text is a promise, so it must change if analyst behaviour changes. A new analyst appears in the tiles automatically but only in the picker if the roster data gives it a voice.
debug: If the list is empty, check the analyst list. If the picker is missing, check the switchboard data.
